desc: Prove the optimal route characterization and derive the exact answer formula from bottleneck \(B\).
Construct a maximum spanning tree of the grid using edge weights \(\min(F_u,F_v)\) efficiently.
Implement binary-lifting LCA preprocessing that returns the minimum edge weight on each tree path.
Integrate the bottleneck formula with queries and verify edge cases.
Check Python time and memory complexity for \(250{,}000\) cells and \(200{,}000\) queries.
